bagPolicy.summary: The bag policy at Gainbridge Fieldhouse requires guests to travel light and subjects them to visual inspections. Bags larger than 6"x9"x1.5” are not allowed.
prohibited: Alcohol, drugs, illegal substances, or any paraphernalia associated with drug use
Beach balls or any projectiles or missiles
Cans, bottles, coolers, or other similar containers
Clothing that displays obscene/offensive language and/or images
Objects that obstruct another guest’s view
Signs, flags, banners larger 11″X17″ or affixed to any pole
Signs that display obscene/offensive language and/or images
Tripods, mono pods, or selfie sticks
Weapons of any type, including chains, knives, firearms, and spiked jewelry
Any other item deemed unacceptable by event/building management
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There are several parking options within walking distance to Gainbridge Fieldhouse, including the Virginia Avenue Parking Garage, which is connected via a sky bridge. Parking passes can be purchased in advance through ParkWhiz.

rideshare.note: Guests with limited mobility may be dropped off on Pennsylvania Street directly in front of the Fieldhouse. This street runs southbound. Do not leave vehicles unattended. Other drivers must use a different drop-off point.

concessions.note: The KeyBank Guest Chef Program at Gainbridge Fieldhouse features local chefs showcasing their signature dishes during Pacers games and select events. Highlights include a variety of cuisines such as classic American, Indian, and soul food, providing fans with a taste of Indy's diverse culinary scene.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Free assistive listening devices are available; email GuestServices@Pacers.com with the event date and time at least one week ahead, then pick one up at the Guest Services Desk on the Main Concourse near Section 2, leaving a valid ID until you return it. Wheelchair escorts from the Ascension St. Vincent Entry Pavilion to your seat are available; ask staff at any entrance.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed. Once you exit past the ticket point, you can't come back into the same event.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Box Office hours are typically Monday-Friday from 12:00 p.m. The Box Office is located in Gainbridge Fieldhouse in the Ascension St.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors open at least one hour before every Gainbridge Fieldhouse event. Exact door times are posted on the Gainbridge Fieldhouse website and social media.
